subject: Television & Streaming
title: Streaming Subscription Fatigue
description: A micro-lesson that makes Streaming Subscription Fatigue usable.

hook.text: To watch everything you want, you now need Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, HBO, Apple, Amazon, and Peacock. Sound familiar?

buildup.text: Cord-cutters escaped $150 cable bills. Now their combined streaming subscriptions cost nearly the same amount.

discovery.text: Surveys show most households subscribe to four or more streaming services but regularly use only two.

twist.text: People started rotating—subscribing for a month, bingeing, canceling, then switching to another service.

climax.text: Streaming recreated the cable bundle problem it promised to solve, just with more apps and more passwords.

punchline.text: We escaped cable and built a more expensive version.

quiz.question: What is 'subscription fatigue' in the context of streaming?
options: Frustration from paying for too many streaming services
